newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA LEV CLOSES FLAT, C.BANK SUPPORT SEEN.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA LEV CLOSES FLAT, C.BANK SUPPORT SEEN.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed flat on opening between 241-243 per dollar after a thin trade on the interbank market as the central bank was seen selling small dollar volumes to clients, dealers said.
"Interbank activity was rather low and the lev fall from the previous close was entirely due to the longer value date of spot deals," a commercial bank dealer said.
The lev closed around 240-241 per dollar on Wednesday.
The central bank was seen selling dollars to final clients near 242.50 levs, containing the lev fall within the limit set by the longer value date.
The lev traditionally weakens on Thursdays on the local market due to the large spread between interest rates on lev- and dollar-denominated investments.
"The central bank has probably sold small volumes today because dollar demand was low," another dealr said.
Central bank officials declined comment. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
